name: Mind The Crates
summary: MIND THE CRATES is a satisfying Sokoban-style puzzle game built around smart crate-pushing challenges and clean, focused level design. Work through 16 stages as you push crates into the right positions, think ahead to avoid dead ends, and solve each puzzle as efficiently as possible. Chase the lowest move count, improve your best completion times, and master every level through careful planning and precise execution.
